download_status: No public source files were downloaded for the checked-in fallback build.
created_for: HHVBP public-only synthetic development and sensitivity analysis

cms_provider_data_home_health.title: CMS Provider Data Catalog / Home Health Services
cms_provider_data_home_health.purpose: Home health national/state/provider quality baselines, Home Health Care - National Data, and public home-health provider datasets.
cms_provider_data_home_health.transformation: Optional marginal benchmark calibration only; never estimates patient-clinician causal effects.

census_acs_5yr_zcta.title: Census ACS 5-year ZCTA data
census_acs_5yr_zcta.purpose: Age distribution, housing type, income/poverty, vehicle access, household composition, and socioeconomic proxies.
census_acs_5yr_zcta.dataset_id: 2024 ACS 5-year API (tables must be configured before retrieval)
census_acs_5yr_zcta.transformation: Configured ACS variables would be aggregated to factor-category marginals by ZCTA; fallback uses expert-configured distributions.

cdc_places_zcta.title: CDC PLACES ZCTA data
cdc_places_zcta.purpose: ZIP/ZCTA-level community health proxies for health_status and comorbidity burden.
cdc_places_zcta.dataset_id: CDC PLACES ZCTA release (year/resource not selected for offline fallback)
cdc_places_zcta.transformation: If enabled, selected prevalence estimates would inform health-status marginals only.

usda_ruca_zip.title: USDA RUCA ZIP/ZCTA data
usda_ruca_zip.purpose: area_type mapping: metropolitan, micropolitan, small_town, rural.
usda_ruca_zip.transformation: Map primary RUCA 1-3 to metropolitan, 4-6 to micropolitan, 7-9 to small_town, and 10 to rural; code 99 remains missing.

zillow_zhvi.title: Zillow ZHVI
zillow_zhvi.purpose: house_price_zip level and house_price_dip flag from user-supplied CSV paths.
zillow_zhvi.dataset_id: Zillow Home Value Index (ZHVI) ZIP time series; file not selected
zillow_zhvi.transformation: If licensing and a local file permit, classify ZIP values relative to configured market quantiles; otherwise use fallback categories.

census_gazetteer_zcta.title: Census Gazetteer / ZCTA centroid data
census_gazetteer_zcta.purpose: ZIP/ZCTA centroids for distance_to_clinic and synthetic clinician service-radius calculations.
census_gazetteer_zcta.dataset_id: 2024 Gazetteer ZIP Code Tabulation Areas file
census_gazetteer_zcta.transformation: Calculate great-circle distance from configured office coordinates; fallback Reno coordinates are synthetic scenario inputs, not downloaded observations.

noaa_climate_normals.title: NOAA Climate Normals or CDO
noaa_climate_normals.dataset_id: U.S. Climate Normals 1991-2020 (optional station crosswalk not selected)
noaa_climate_normals.transformation: Optional station-to-ZIP proxy for driving-condition scenario categories; excluded from fallback observations.

cms_synpuf_optional.title: CMS SynPUF
cms_synpuf_optional.purpose: Optional claims-like schema testing only; disabled by default and not valid threshold-performance evidence.
cms_synpuf_optional.warning: Do not use SynPUF to claim threshold performance validation.
